Ubisoft lays off 166 staff in Montreal and Quebec studios

Ubisoft is laying off staff in its vast Montreal and Quebec studios, with 166 roles being lost "to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs."

007 First Light wins GOTY at 2026 TIGA Awards, Dovetail Games takes home four accolades including Best Publisher

IO Interactive's 007 First Light received Game of the Year at the 2026 TIGA Awards, while Dovetail Games earned four awards, including Best Publisher and Best Educational, Serious or Simulation Game for Train Sim World 6.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 debuts as top-selling game in US for October 2026

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led US sales in October according to Circana, marking the 19th consecutive year a Call of Duty title has been the best-selling game during its launch month.

US Senate hearing examines child safety on Roblox, considers bipartisan bill to bypass forced arbitration

The US Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Counterterrorism held a hearing this week to examine child safety on Roblox and consider a bipartisan bill that would allow families and victims to bypass forced arbitration.

The future of British gaming is more than just games | Opinion

The UK has one of the most creative and innovative video games industries in the world. From independent studios developing original ideas to established businesses creating globally recognised franchises, British developers have consistently shown that they can compete on the international stage.
